Follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md` as the shared development and safety policy. Before coding, inspect `SKILLS-INDEX.md`, choose applicable skills, and read each selected canonical `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` in full.

The canonical skills live under `skills/`. Native copies in `.github/skills/` and `.agents/skills/` are generated by `scripts/sync-skills.ps1`; do not edit those copies independently. Skill discovery depends on the installed Copilot surface and version, so verify it rather than assuming it.
